data.narrative:
Aslan, a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Chase Reid and Ansel Tessier, has raised $20.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparables across the sector—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $20.3M total raised as a baseline and applies a 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier, yielding $51M. Peer-Median analysis references 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A). The median across these four peers is $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The two methods diverge substantially, reflecting the wide dispersion in Defense & Security valuations at early stages.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $43M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $375M. The wide band reflects material uncertainty around whether Aslan's valuation aligns with lower-funded Seed peers or higher-funded Series A comparables. Key variables include product maturity, customer traction, and defensibility relative to the peer set. Resolution of stage timing and customer momentum would meaningfully narrow this range.
